note: Art direction cards - coherent pose x lighting x composition x palette x medium bundles for gen.py artistic --direction (see art_directions.py). A card PINS the listed slots; unpinned slots still roll their __wildcard__ per seed. Interface with the object/background line: cards never fill a background slot; bg_brief is a one-line lighting brief (brightness / temperature / source direction only) the other line may implement with concrete entities. Sync rule (enforced by validate): if the primary base has a model_quirks neg_add, the card's neg_add must contain it verbatim; if the base is no_freeu, the card's flags must include --no-freeu.
